name: @devhq/docs
description: DevHQ documentation: Markdown sources plus generators and a link checker. No runtime or install-time dependencies.

scripts.gen: npm run gen:api && npm run gen:permissions && npm run gen:errors && npm run gen:config
scripts.check: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/gen-api.ts --check && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/gen-permissions.ts --check && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/gen-errors.ts --check && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/gen-config.ts --check && npm run links
